item.title: How to build a todo app in React
item.description: Building a todo application is a classic way to learn React fundamentals including state management, event handling, and component composition. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built todo-style interfaces for task management systems, project tracking tools, and checklist applications. The most effective approach uses useState for managing todos, useEffect for persistence, and controlled inputs for adding new items. This provides a fully functional todo app with all essential features.
